name: N8n SEO Blog Automation
headline: n8n SEO Blog Automation: AI Content & Publishing
short_description: Automated SEO blog content creation and optimization workflow using n8n with AI-powered content generation and SEO analysis
author: virajshrivastav

sections.overview:
This n8n workflow automates the complete blog content lifecycle, from keyword research and AI-powered content generation to SEO optimization and multi-platform publishing. It integrates with leading AI services like OpenAI and Claude, SEO tools such as SEMrush and Ahrefs, and popular CMS platforms including WordPress, Ghost, and Contentful. The workflow handles keyword integration, meta tag generation, readability analysis, and performance tracking to ensure published content meets search engine standards. Content teams, digital marketing agencies, and e-commerce businesses use this skill to scale content production while maintaining consistent brand voice and SEO quality across channels.
Generate and publish SEO-optimized blog posts at scale across multiple platforms
Create product descriptions and guides with built-in keyword optimization for e-commerce
Maintain consistent content calendars with automated scheduling and publishing
Analyze competitors and identify trending topics for content strategy planning
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/virajshrivastav/n8n-seo-blog-automation`
sections.usage:
```
Create a detailed SEO-optimized blog post about [TOPIC] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include an introduction, 3-5 main sections with subheadings, and a conclusion. Ensure the content is engaging, informative, and incorporates relevant keywords naturally. Also, provide a meta description and 5 suggested hashtags for social media promotion.
```
